name: atlasent-mcp-server
description: AtlaSent for AI agents: with an API key, consequential actions wait for approval and get a signed record. With no key: an unsigned local demo.
long_description: Before an agent's tool call changes a real system (a production deploy, a data export, an access grant), the agent asks AtlaSent first. With an API key, risky actions wait for a person in your organization to approve them, and every decision gets a signed record, including who approved it when the decision relied on an approval. With no key the server runs a local demo: an in-process rules engine with unsigned permits that protects nothing. Also includes a read-only evidence-gap report that lists CI deploy steps with no approval gate in front of them. Source and docs: https://github.com/Atlasent/atlasent-mcp-server

api_key.title: AtlaSent API key
api_key.description: Sign up free at console.atlasent.io and choose Connect an AI agent. Leave blank for the unsigned local demo.
